description: This file defines a controller class for managing 'Total' extensions within the OpenCart admin system. It provides functionalities to list, install, and uninstall total-related extensions, including permission checks, dynamic loading of extensions, and rendering the extension management view.

classes.name: Total
classes.description: Controller class for managing total extensions in OpenCart admin system, including listing, installation, and uninstallation of extensions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Outputs the list of total extensions by rendering the 'extension/total' view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Loads available and installed total extensions, prepares data, and returns the rendered view for managing extensions.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation of a total extension, including permission checks, registering autoloaders, and invoking extension-specific install routines.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles uninstallation of a total extension, including permission checks and invoking extension-specific uninstall routines.
